Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner unnecessarily narrowed the task by insisting on standardizing to USA release dates and even selecting the latest USA date as “canonical,” despite the question simply asking which film was released earlier. This scope misinterpretation ignored the clear worldwide release information (Xenoa released in 2007) and led to repetitive, unproductive searches. It also introduced a potentially incorrect premise (“Xenoa USA release is listed in 2013”) without proper verification. The error could directly yield a wrong comparison versus the straightforward global release dates (Xenoa 2007 vs. Divorce Invitation 2012/2013).
